entries.subject: units.*.model
entries.note: A list of models in a step's `model` or in `model_profile` is retired. A step names one alias; a stronger model is reached only through `escalation`, one tier up, on a repeated blocker from a trusted judge (LAD §2.8).

entries.subject: units.*.effort_ladder, units.*.escalation
entries.note: A step may declare an effort ladder and one model escalation; both climb only on evidence (LAD).

entries.subject: units.*.gate.judge.risk
entries.note: A gate's judge may be raised by a model-free risk rule, calibrated per level (JRK).

entries.subject: ComplexitySwitch, Measure, stock, Map
entries.note: Measured switches, complexity switches with a rules file, and the sequential map (SWM, CXR, MAP).

entries.subject: Ask, Question, Wait, Parallel
entries.note: The ask unit, the event wait and parallel read-only branches (ASK, HUM, CMP).

entries.subject: units.*.gate.fallback, units.*.deadline_s, units.*.self_check
entries.note: A gate's fallback target, a deadline on a wait or ask, and a step's check preview (FLX, CHK §2.5).

entries.subject: CheckContext.git, CheckContext.changed_paths
entries.note: Outside a git repository a check receives `git = None`; `changed_paths` on the context is filled in both cases. `GitFacts.pushed` is now set from the remote-tracking refs (WSP §2.4, CHK §2.1).

entries.subject: outcome deliverables
entries.note: A deliverable is required only on a path that produces it, so a run that took another switch arm is no longer failed for an artifact its path never makes (OUT).

entries.subject: @repository
entries.note: A step or check may list `@repository` among its commands to take the prefixes the repository declares in `tempergraph.commands.json` (CHK §2.2).

entries.subject: update, upgrade, evals run|report|grade|harvest|replay, promote-check, carry, hooks, self-check
entries.note: New verbs of release 2 (UPD, WUP, EVS, PRO, CAR, CLI §2.2).

entries.subject: --state-root, --pause-before, --answers, --apply-deadline, --unit, --escalate, --carry
entries.note: New options of `run` and `resume`; `--pause-before` was refused `not_in_release` before.

entries.subject: state root outside git
entries.note: A folder outside a git repository may hold runs: the engine no longer refuses with `not_git`, it keeps the state in `<start dir>/.tempergraph/` or the nearest one upward (WSP §2.4).

entries.subject: config/hooks.json
entries.note: Lifecycle hooks: an operator's command run detached on a run event, with a facts file (CLI §2.2).
